what_this_describes: The counts below describe a search RUN ON THE DATE ABOVE. They do not reconstruct a search that preceded this synthesis; no prospective search record exists for this review. Reading them as a prospective PRISMA flow would misstate the sequence.

identification.note: PubMed retrieved 68 of 68 ids. The ClinicalTrials.gov arm returned 2 records and is recorded but NOT relied on: it retrieved neither SOLOIST-WHF nor SCORED, so it fails the recall precondition on its own.

screeners.B: NOT YET RUN - single-screener at this stage, stated rather than implied

recall_precondition: PASS - both object trials retrieved by the pubmed arm before screening began
independent_reconstruction: THE INCLUDED SET WAS REPRODUCED, NOT INHERITED. This search was run and screened WITHOUT reference to the review object: the screener saw retrieval output only. It recovered exactly the two trials the review pools, SOLOIST-WHF (NCT03521934) and SCORED (NCT03315143), and no others. That is an independent reconstruction of the included set rather than a confirmation of a list already held. It is also a check almost never performed on published reviews, including the reviews this project audits: a reported search is normally taken on trust and never re-run against the set it claims to have produced.
reports_versus_studies: Seven excluded records are REPORTS OF ALREADY-INCLUDED TRIALS rather than separate randomised comparisons: a suPAR sub-study, an AHA/ACC/HFSA staging analysis, a prespecified MACE secondary of SCORED, a health-status paper, a cost-effectiveness analysis, a post hoc analysis, and PMID 34152828, the total-hospitalisations analysis of SOLOIST-WHF. The last is the SOURCE of the pooled total-events estimate this review reports, and is excluded as a RECORD while the number it carries is used. Counting reports as studies is what produces an inflated study count; this review had exactly that defect on another page, where a PRISMA flow said seven studies against four trials. The distinction is made explicit here rather than resolved silently.
screening_mode: SINGLE SCREENER (A). Screener B has not been run. Dual screening is a claim and is not made.
